tldr: the Sun through the 3rd house brings attention to messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 3rd house, it brings attention to messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
